sentences.text: Tylenol -LSB- ˈtaɪlənɒl -RSB- is a brand of drugs advertised for reducing pain , reducing fever , and relieving the symptoms of allergies , cold , cough headache , and influenza .	pain	analgesic	fever	fever	allergies	allergy	cold	common cold	cough	cough	influenza	influenza

The active ingredient of its original flagship product is paracetamol -LRB- known in the United States as acetaminophen -RRB- , an analgesic and antipyretic .	paracetamol	paracetamol	analgesic	analgesic	antipyretic	antipyretic
Like the words acetaminophen and paracetamol , the brand name Tylenol is derived from the chemical name for the compound , N-aceTYL-para-aminophENOL -LRB- APAP -RRB- .	paracetamol	paracetamol
The brand name is owned by McNeil Consumer Healthcare , a subsidiary of Johnson & Johnson .	McNeil Consumer Healthcare	McNeil Consumer Healthcare	Johnson & Johnson	Johnson & Johnson
As of 2017 the `` Tylenol '' brand was used in Brazil , Canada , China , Egypt , Lebanon , Myanmar , Oman , Philippines , Portugal , Spain , Switzerland , Thailand , United States , and Vietnam .
